cases.explain: The preposition над (over) governs the instrumental case.
Еда is the grammatical subject of the sentence and stands in the nominative case.
The verb взять (to take) is transitive and requires the accusative case for its direct object.

reading.ru: Иов ответил, «А если взвесить мои страдания, мою беду положить на весы, они перевесили бы песок морей»
reading.question: What would happen if Job's suffering and calamity were weighed on scales?
options: They would be heavier than the sand of the seas
They would be lighter than air
reading.correct: They would be heavier than the sand of the seas
reading.explain: Job says his anguish and calamity would be heavier than the sand of the seas if weighed.

reading.ru: Стрелы всемогущего во мне, Напоен мой дух их ядом
reading.question: What has filled Job's spirit?
reading.explain: Job states that the arrows of the Almighty are within him and his spirit drinks up their poison.

reading.ru: Разве ревет дикий осел на пастбище? Разве мычит бык над кормушкой?
reading.question: What is Job asking about the behavior of wild animals?
options: Whether they cry out when they have food
reading.correct: Whether they cry out when they have food
reading.explain: Job is questioning whether a wild donkey brays when it has grass or an ox lows when it has fodder — suggesting that suffering should have a cause.

reading.ru: Я гнушаюсь прикоснуться к такой пище, Вот что в несчастье стало моей пищей
reading.question: What does Job refuse to touch because of his suffering?
reading.explain: Job refuses to touch food without salt — loathsome food — because suffering has become his sustenance.

reading.ru: О, когда сбылась бы просьба моя, и Бог исполнил бы мою надежду
reading.question: What does Job wish God would do?
options: Grant his request and fulfill his hope
reading.correct: Grant his request and fulfill his hope
reading.explain: Job expresses his desire that God would grant his request (for death) and fulfill his longing.

reading.question: What has Job maintained?
options: He has not rejected the words of the Holy One
reading.correct: He has not rejected the words of the Holy One
reading.explain: Job asserts that despite his suffering, he has not denied the words of the Holy One.
